title: NNDC wallet cards 2023: 99mTc half-life 6.0073 h, uncertainty 7
summary: The October 2023 wallet-card row for the first isomer 99mTc prints half-life 6.0073 h with uncertainty 7.
body: The October 2023 Nuclear Wallet Cards row for 99mTc prints half-life 6.0073 h (hour), uncertainty 7. The booklet says an m after the mass number is the first isomer. The booklet's half-life note says the value is followed by the unit (s: second, m: minute, h: hour, d: day, y: year) and that the uncertainty follows the unit and is given in italics. Superscripts in powers of ten were read from the smaller glyphs in the PDF. Italics were not a separate character. The uncertainty is the integer in that position. This is the isomer row, not the 99Tc ground-state row.
